messages:
tomas-support: Heads up — customer SUP-12345 (Private VPC) reports their console shows zero traffic since ~12:15 UTC. App still serving traffic though. Can someone triage?

deploy-bot: deploy finished env=private-us-east commit=fe3a9b2 (ingress config updated)

anna-support: On it. Which tenant id / header are they using?

 t omas-support: tenant header is `X-Tenant: acme-inc`. Customer supplied a small header dump — looks like X-Tenant is missing on requests hitting our telemetry endpoint.

mike-sre: quick check — do we have ingress rewrites that could strip custom headers?

jess-platform: I noticed an ingress change pushed at 12:09 to strip a set of headers (security hardening). That may have unintentionally removed X-Tenant.

mike-sre: Confirmed in change history: ingress rule `strip_headers: [X-Tenant]` was added in commit fe3a9b2. Nginx shows `proxy_set_header X-Tenant '';`. That would make private telemetry unable to route by tenant.

anna-support: That matches why the Dashboard (which aggregates by tenant) shows nothing. Telemetry backend treats missing tenant header as unrouteable and drops metrics.

 t omas-support: Repro steps I used for the customer:
```
# without tenant header - metrics missing
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://private.ingress.example/v1/requests
# with tenant header - metrics arrive
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-Tenant: acme-inc" https://private.ingress.example/v1/requests
```
Response logs: when X-Tenant absent requests return 200 from app but telemetry sidecar logs `WARN missing tenant header -> drop` and no datapoint emitted.

jess-platform: Mitigation: rolling back the header-strip change for private ingress only. Also adding a test in CI to ensure X-Tenant is preserved for Private clusters. I'll open a short-lived canary revert.

deploy-bot: rollback started by jess-platform for ingress-strip-fe3a9b2 id=rr-789

deploy-bot: rollback complete (2m)

mike-sre: After rollback, I see telemetry pickup for tenant acme-inc within 3 minutes. Console refreshed and counts returning.

 t omas-support: Customer confirmed metrics are back. They saw historical datapoints reappear and new traffic streaming in :tada:. Will follow up with a postmortem and add an alert on sudden tenant-drops.

anna-support: Filing follow-up SUP-12345 with root cause: ingress header strip on private clusters removed X-Tenant; action items: revert rule, add CI test, add alert, patch docs about required headers.

jess-platform: I'll draft the postmortem; will also make the ingress rule explicit (only strip public/untrusted headers) and whitelist X-Tenant for private routes.

mike-sre: Suggested quick guard: sidecar should validate presence of X-Tenant and emit a specific metric `telemetry.missing_tenant` so we can alert earlier.

 t omas-support: Agreed. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
